title: Victory to Chamunda
translation: Victory to you, O Goddess Chamunda! Victory to you who take away the suffering of beings! Victory, O Goddess who is everywhere! O Kalaratri, salutations to you.
translation_hi: हे देवी चामुंडा, आपकी जय हो! प्राणियों की पीड़ा हरने वाली, आपकी जय हो! हे सर्वव्यापिनी देवी, आपकी जय हो! हे कालरात्रि, आपको नमस्कार है।

words.note: Slayer of Chanda and Munda. Vocative.
The seventh form worshipped in Navaratri.

grammar: Feminine vocatives: -a nouns take -e (चामुण्डे), -i nouns take -i (देवि, कालरात्रि). Compare बाले in Lilavati verse 1.
Arti: 'pain' (not the same word as arati, the lamp ceremony).
